channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Netanyahu at Gaza Yellow Line: ‘We are not withdrawing, we are staying’
item.description: Netanyahu visits IDF forces near Gaza’s Yellow Line, declares Israel will remain in place and vows to complete the disarmament of Hamas.

item.title: Anti-Israel protest moved away from Budapest Cholent Festival
item.description: Hungarian authorities redirected a planned anti-Israel demonstration away from the entrance to Budapest’s Cholent Festival following concerns over a targeted provocation against local Jews.

item.title: Expect a chaotic Fall 2026 semester in New York City
item.description: Unlike his predecessor Eric Adams, who was mayor during the Spring 2024 semester of encampments (the most confrontational semester in decades), Mamdani is on the side of the Student Intifada. Opinion.

item.title: Jewish Civic Engagement: The 360° Approach
item.description: The Jewish community and its allies need to adopt a comprehensive 360° strategy to confront the challenges of modern Jew Hatred. Opinion.

item.title: Iran threatens to ‘shatter’ US
item.description: Tehran escalates threats after US strikes, demanding compensation for passage through the Strait of Hormuz as IRGC reports attacks on US assets across region.

item.title: Rabbi Dov Lando signals: Degel Hatorah is not bound to Netanyahu
item.description: Rabbi Dov Lando says the haredi Torah world faces growing persecution and stresses that Degel Hatorah does not depend on any prime minister.

item.title: “Jewish" or “Israeli"? Yoseph Haddad responds to controversy over singing Hatikva
item.description: Amcha Yisrael candidate responded to the claim that he wants to change “Hatikva," clarifying that this is simply his personal way of singing the national anthem.

item.title: Former Bedouin soldier indicted for plotting to join ISIS
item.description: Prosecutors say suspect studied weapons, missile and drone production, and military tactics while preparing to join ISIS in Syria or Africa.

item.title: Haredi fund offers draft evaders NIS 1,000 a day in prison
item.description: Senior Lithuanian haredi rabbis back 'Prison 1,000' fund designed to reward draft evaders for each day spent behind bars.

item.title: Deadly Sinai bus crash leaves 16 dead, dozens injured
item.description: Bus overturns on Egypt's Dahab-Nuweiba road, killing at least 16 and injuring 26.

item.title: Katz warns Iran could attack on Jewish holidays: ‘Our planes are ready’
item.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz says mounting pressure on Tehran could trigger direct confrontation, stressing Israel is prepared for defense and attack in coordination with US.

item.title: Smotrich: Chief of Staff insisted Givati soldiers face harsh punishment
item.description: Minister Bezalel Smotrich claims brigade commanders wanted to close the case, but says the IDF Chief of Staff demanded severe punishment for the soldiers.

item.title: Uman-bound haredi draft evaders stopped at airport, Taba border
item.description: Six haredi men caught trying to leave Israel at Ben Gurion Airport; dozens more headed for Uman stopped over active exit bans.

item.title: Dermer sends blunt message to Vance critics at RJC conference
item.description: Former minister Ron Dermer praises JD Vance’s role in Israel’s war with Iran as the vice president faces growing criticism from pro-Israel groups.

item.title: IDF eliminates senior Hamas security commander in Gaza
item.description: Talal Badawi advanced attacks against troops, Israeli civilians, while working to rebuild Hamas capabilities in violation of the ceasefire, IDF reveals.

item.title: Ben Gvir gives Likud hours to decide on MK transfer
item.description: Otzma Yehudit warns that delays could kill the deal as Ben Gvir demands immediate action on Tali Gottliv’s possible move to his party.

item.title: Police name man suspected of poisoning baby food
item.description: Suspect accused of injecting sedatives into fruit purées intended for babies is a 40-year-old resident of southern Israel; court extends detention until Sunday.

item.title: Two babies fight for their lives after home birth, vitamin K refusal
item.description: Hadassah doctors save two newborns in critical condition - one suffering brain-threatening complications after a home birth, the other massive bleeding after not receiving vitamin K.

item.title: Massive security breach: 22 Palestinian antennas found inside Jerusalem’s Old City
item.description: Calls to Israel Police from Palestinian SIM cards routed to Palestinian Authority police; experts warn unauthorized network could pose serious security threat.

item.title: Netanyahu's ultimatum to the small parties
item.description: The prime minister met with rabbis and leading figures in Religious Zionist communities to demand action from the smaller parties in the demographic.

item.title: Hezbollah launches explosive drones at IDF troops, Israel strikes back
item.description: IDF downs one of two explosive drones targeting soldiers before striking Hezbollah terror infrastructure in southern Lebanon.

item.title: Likud moves to dismantle Ofer Winter’s new party
item.description: 'Amcha Yisrael' head Ofer Winter rejects proposal offering him second place on a Smotrich-Feiglin slate and spots for his allies in Likud: ‘Israel demands something new.’

item.title: Europe has become Islam's playground
item.description: Is Europe so shortsighted that it does not realize that Islamic mega-gifts have strings attached? Or does it simply not care? Opinion.

item.title: IDF: Interceptors likely launched towards false target
item.description: IDF: Following the sirens that sounded overnight (Wednesday), regarding a hostile aircraft infiltration in several areas in northern Israel, an initial assessment indicates that several interceptors were likely launched toward a false target.

item.title: Does Jewish existence conflict with human survival?
item.description: Unlike Dana Nessel, most Jews still consider the existence of the Jewish people, and the Jewish state, to be a Jewish value. They’re proud to be Jews-and they’re equally proud of the role Jews have played in human history. Opinion.

item.title: Amid rising antisemitism, South African Jews choose to strengthen their identity
item.description: As hostility and anti-Israel sentiment intensify, Cape Town’s Jewish community responds by expanding Jewish life with a new Torah study initiative for seniors.

item.title: Apple Maps renames Lake Ontario 'Lake America' for US users
item.description: Apple Maps has renamed Lake Ontario “Lake America" for US users, following Trump’s order, while Canadians will continue to see the lake’s original name.

item.title: Bessent: US will 'economically asphyxiate' Iran until it agrees to a deal
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says the US will “economically asphyxiate" Iran by targeting IRGC assets until Tehran agrees to a peace deal.

item.title: Sa’ar warns UK: If Britain acts against Israel, Israel will act
item.description: Foreign Minister Gideon Sa’ar warns Britain of retaliation if London imposes sanctions over Israeli construction plans in the E1 area.

item.title: Winter tells supporters: Don’t be swayed by the pressure, we are the right
item.description: At a rally for his new party, Ofer Winter tells activists, “Don’t be swayed by the pressure. We represent the true voice of the Israeli people and will sit with Netanyahu."
